name: Caldes de Montbui (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical parts, the first yellow with the black cauldron of the arms, the second divided horizontally white with a red cross throughout above four red pales on yellow.
history: The flag was approved on 6 July 2017 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7412 of 14 July 2017; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 composed of two equal vertical parts, the first yellow with the black cauldron of the arms at the centre, the second a horizontal bicolour of white with a red cross throughout and the four bars.

features.role: cauldron of the arms, 3/8 of the height
red cross throughout on white in the upper fly
four red pales on yellow in the lower fly
